shots.scenario: Ishaan tiptoes down a hallway with a toy truck hidden behind his back, glancing at the camera.
dialogue: I only borrowed it. Nobody saw.

shots.scenario: Ishaan stands listening with a thoughtful face, mouth closed, soft kitchen light.
dialogue: Beta, karma is like an echo. Whatever you send out, the world sends back.

shots.scenario: Ishaan holds the toy truck out toward the camera with a shy smile.
dialogue: Here. You can have your truck back.

shots.scenario: Ishaan flops on a messy bedroom floor with a sulky face, looking into the camera.
dialogue: I do not want to clean my room.

shots.scenario: Ishaan looks at the mess with a thoughtful expression, mouth closed.
dialogue: Dharma means doing your duty, even when it is boring. Today your duty is tidy.

shots.scenario: Ishaan salutes the camera, holding a toy bin, grinning.
dialogue: Dharma mode. Activated.

shots.scenario: Ishaan holds a slipper above his head, staring up at a small spider on the wall, looking at the camera.
dialogue: That spider is scary. Getting the shoe.

shots.scenario: Ishaan lowers the slipper slowly, looking at the spider, mouth closed.
dialogue: Ahimsa, beta. Be gentle with every creature. That spider is just a tiny neighbor.

shots.scenario: Ishaan waves up at the spider and smiles into the camera.
dialogue: You may stay. Please keep to the ceiling.

shots.scenario: Ishaan kneels by a pot of soil, chin on his hands, staring at the camera impatiently.
dialogue: I planted a seed. Why is nothing happening?

shots.scenario: Ishaan looks closely at the soil, curious, mouth closed.
dialogue: Dhairya, beta. Roots grow in the dark before any leaf appears. Waiting is growing too.

shots.scenario: Ishaan sits cross-legged beside the pot, smiling calmly at the camera.
dialogue: I am waiting. This is me growing.

shots.scenario: Ishaan sits at a dinner table staring at a bowl of dal, wrinkling his nose at the camera.
dialogue: Dal again? I wanted pizza.

shots.scenario: Ishaan looks down at the bowl, thoughtful, mouth closed.
dialogue: Kritagya, beta. Many children would celebrate this bowl. Notice who cooked it with love.

shots.scenario: Ishaan takes a spoonful and beams at the camera.
dialogue: Thank you, Dadi. This dal is amazing.

shots.scenario: Ishaan stands proudly holding a small trophy, chin up, looking at the camera.
dialogue: I am the best. Nobody can beat me.

shots.scenario: Ishaan looks down at the trophy, a little ashamed, mouth closed.
dialogue: Ahamkara is when I grows bigger than we. The tallest tree still needs the soil.

shots.scenario: Ishaan holds the trophy out toward the camera with both hands, smiling.
dialogue: We won. Together. Even Aryan.

shots.scenario: Ishaan stands outdoors in a park, one hand stretched up, looking at the camera in dismay.
dialogue: My balloon flew away. I want it back.

shots.scenario: Ishaan gazes up at the sky, calming down, mouth closed.
dialogue: Vairagya, beta. Enjoy things fully, then let them go lightly. Joy belongs to the moment.

shots.scenario: Ishaan waves up at the sky with a smile toward the camera.
dialogue: Bye, balloon. Thanks for the fun.

shots.scenario: Ishaan sits at a desk with a pencil, head in his hands, looking at the camera, distracted.
dialogue: Everything is distracting. I cannot focus.

shots.scenario: Ishaan looks at the page, steadying himself, mouth closed.
dialogue: Arjuna saw only the bird's eye. Not the tree, not the crowd. Focus makes the arrow fly true.

shots.scenario: Ishaan points his pencil at the page with a determined look at the camera.
dialogue: Eyes on the homework. Only the homework.

shots.scenario: Ishaan stands beside a broken blue vase with his hands behind his back, looking at the camera.
dialogue: The vase broke by itself. Maybe.

shots.scenario: Ishaan lowers his eyes, conscience stirring, mouth closed.
dialogue: Satya, beta. The truth feels heavy for one minute and light for a lifetime.

shots.scenario: Ishaan looks straight into the camera, relieved and honest.
dialogue: Dadi, it was me. I am sorry.

shots.scenario: Ishaan sits in a dim living room with a small clay lamp in front of him, looking at the camera.
dialogue: Why do we light so many diyas?

shots.scenario: Ishaan watches the flame glow, wide-eyed, mouth closed.
dialogue: Because a little light removes a lot of darkness. Be your own small light, beta.

shots.scenario: Ishaan holds the lit diya up, glowing, smiling at the camera.
dialogue: Small light. Big difference.
